docs.title: AvalonStudios Script Docs
docs.text:
Benvenuto nella documentazione ufficiale degli script FiveM e RedM di AvalonStudios.

Qui trovi la reference completa per tutti gli script: configurazione, export disponibili ed esempi di utilizzo.

docs.title: Script FiveM
docs.text: Script Descrizione Export avalon_coltivation Sistema di coltivazione piante ✅ avalon_dustman Lavoro netturbino (singolo/gruppo) ❌ avalon_electrician Lavoro elettricista con minigiochi ❌ avalon_lumberjack Lavoro taglialegna con minigioco ❌ avalon_mining Lavoro minatore con minigioco ❌ avalon_mounts Creature cavalcabili (draghi, grifoni, pegasi...) ✅ avalon_party Sistema party MMORPG con HUD, barre vitali, dungeon ✅ avalon_robbery Sistema rapina negozi ❌ avalon_trash Ricerca oggetti nei bidoni ❌

docs.title: Script RedM
docs.text: Script Descrizione Export avalon_combat Combattimento corpo a corpo con stili, armi, parata, attacchi accoppiati e NPC ✅

docs.title: Dipendenze Comuni (FiveM)
docs.text:
Tutti gli script FiveM richiedono le seguenti risorse attive sul server:

  • ox_lib — Libreria base
  • ox_target — Sistema interazioni
  • ox_inventory — Gestione inventario
  • es_extended — Framework ESX

Suggerimento

Assicurati che tutte le dipendenze siano avviate prima degli script Avalon nell'server.cfg.

Gli script RedM sono standalone: le loro dipendenze sono nella panoramica RedM.

docs.title: Come usare gli Export
docs.text:
Gli export permettono ad altri script di richiamare funzioni di uno script Avalon senza dipendenze dirette nel codice.

ClientServer 
-- Sintassi base per chiamare un export client-side
exports['nome-resource']:NomeFunzione(parametro1, parametro2)

-- Sintassi base per chiamare un export server-side
exports['nome-resource']:NomeFunzione(parametro1, parametro2)

Importante

Gli export client si chiamano solo da script lato client. Gli export server si chiamano solo da script lato server.

Documentazione realizzata da AvalonStudios — GitHub

Welcome to the official FiveM and RedM script documentation for AvalonStudios.

Here you'll find the complete reference for all scripts: configuration, available exports, and usage examples.

docs.title: Common Dependencies (FiveM)
docs.text:
All FiveM scripts require the following resources to be running:

  • ox_lib — Base library
  • ox_target — Interaction system
  • ox_inventory — Inventory management
  • es_extended — ESX Framework

Tip

Make sure all dependencies are started before Avalon scripts in your server.cfg.

RedM scripts are standalone: their dependencies are listed in the RedM overview.

docs.title: How to Use Exports
docs.text:
Exports allow other scripts to call functions from an Avalon script without direct code dependencies.

ClientServer 
-- Basic syntax to call a client-side export
exports['resource-name']:FunctionName(param1, param2)

-- Basic syntax to call a server-side export
exports['resource-name']:FunctionName(param1, param2)

Important

Client exports can only be called from client-side scripts. Server exports can only be called from server-side scripts.

Documentation by AvalonStudios — GitHub

docs.title: RedM Scripts Overview
docs.text: AvalonStudios RedM scripts are standalone: they do not depend on a framework and connect to the other systems on the server through exports and events.

docs.title: Script List
docs.text: Script Version Client Exports Server Exports Database avalon_combat beta ✅ 10 ✅ 28 ❌

docs.title: Dependencies per Script
docs.text:
avalon_combat  → OneSync, avalon_anims_* animation packs

Animation packs

Combat styles come from the Avalon animation packs (avalon_anims_*): each pack ships its own styles and avalon_combat loads them on its own. See Styles.

docs.title: avalon_combat
docs.text:
Melee combat system for RedM. Every style (werewolf, vampire, katana, sword and shield, pugilist, mages...) uses the animations from the Avalon packs. Hits are calculated by the script: every frame it follows hands, feet and blades along the animation and hits the peds they cross. Damage always goes through the server.

It includes: light and heavy combos, paired attacks (two peds animated together), parry and counterattack, wielded weapons and shields, sprint, dodge, leap and flight for creatures, NPCs that fight on their own, and exports to connect levels, abilities, health bars and spells.

Version: beta | Author: Avalon | Game: RedM | Framework: standalone

docs.title: Dependencies
docs.text:
Resource Required What it is for OneSync ✅ NPC fighters and parry (state bags) avalon_weapons_rdr2 ❌ Optional: the weapon models of the shipped config. The weapons you already have work too (Weapons and Shields) avalon_shields_tint ❌ Optional: the shield models of the shipped config. The shields you already have work too Animation packs avalon_anims_* ✅ at least one The animations and styles (see Styles)

No framework required: the script works on peds and players. Link it to inventories, levels or health bars through the exports.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
1. Copy the avalon_combat/ folder into resources/
  2. Start the animation packs and the resources of your weapon and shield models, then the resource:
# ... the resources of your weapons and shields
ensure avalon_anims_werewolf
ensure avalon_anims_vampire
ensure avalon_anims_ka_02
# ... the other packs you use
ensure avalon_combat

Pack order

A pack started after avalon_combat (or restarted) is still picked up: its styles are added as soon as it starts.

docs.title: Styles
docs.text:
Styles come from the animation packs. Each pack ships an avalon_combat.lua file with its own styles and declares it in its fxmanifest.lua. avalon_combat collects them on its own through the pack's CombatStyles export.

Style Pack Weapon Guard Extra werewolf avalon_anims_werewolf claws game's (bare hands) sprint, dodge, leap, paired attacks vampire avalon_anims_vampire claws own flight, boost, paired attacks succube avalon_anims_succube claws game's (bare hands) flight, boost, paired attacks katana katana1 katana3 katana4 avalon_anims_ka_02 _01 _03 _04 xur_katana game's (blade) sword sword2 sword3 avalon_anims_sw_01 _02 _03 xur_machete2 game's (blade) sword_shield sword_shield2 sword_shield3 avalon_anims_sns_01 _02 _03 swn2craft + shield own / own / game's twinsword avalon_anims_twinsword01 xur_katana2 in both hands game's (blade) hammer2h avalon_anims_hammer2h hammermoore game's (blade) orientalmonk avalon_anims_orientalmonk giga game's (blade) pugilist avalon_anims_p_01 bare hands game's (bare hands) firemage mage witch wizard avalon_anims_firemage_01 _mage_01 _witch_01 _wizard hands / staff game's (bare hands)

Spells

For now the mage styles hit with their hands, with a longer reach (as the spell would). Staffs are visual only: the point spells will come from is read with the client export GetCastPoint().

To write a style of your own see Creating a Style.

docs.title: Commands and Keys
docs.text:
Debug only

All chat commands exist only with AvalonCombat.Debug = true in config/config.lua: they are for setting up and testing styles, weapons and NPCs. On a live server leave Debug = false and put players into combat from your own script with the server export SetStyle. The keys always work.

docs.title: Combat Mode
docs.text:
Command Description /avalon_combat <style> Enter combat with that style (with no argument it lists the styles) /avalon_combat off Leave combat Key Action Left click Light combo (press again during the attack for the next hit) Right click Heavy combo R Paired attack on the ped in front (for styles that have them) or special combo CTRL (held) Guard E Lock on to the ped you aim at with the camera (red diamond above the head): attacks and paired attacks go to them. Press E again to release Shift Sprint (werewolf) · flight (flying styles, in the air) Alt Dodge (werewolf) · boost (flying styles) Shift + Space Leap (werewolf) · takeoff and landing (flying styles)

Who reacts to hits

Light and heavy hits only deal damage. The special combo, paired attacks and attacks with react = true also make the victim stagger or fall.

docs.title: Test and Tuning Commands
docs.text: Command Description /avalon_attack <id> Perform an attack of the current style (id or clip name) /avalon_pair [name] Perform a paired attack on the ped in front /avalon_pair_offset <name> <x> <y> <yaw> Move the victim of a paired attack (this client only) /avalon_weapon <name\|off> Change the weapon in the right hand /avalon_offhand <name\|off> Change the weapon in the left hand /avalon_shield <name\|off> Change the shield /avalon_weapon_offset <x y z rx ry rz> [bone] Adjust the weapon position and print the line to copy into the config (also _offhand_offset, _shield_offset) /avalon_sound <name> Play a sound from the config /avalon_sound_game <set> <name> [bank] Try any sound from the game /avalon_npc <style> [team] [model] [scale] Create an NPC fighter 4 m in front of you /avalon_npc_clear Delete the NPCs you created /avalon_npc_info State of the NPC fighters within 30 m /avalon_dummy [model] · /avalon_dummy_clear Stationary dummies to hit /avalon_hitbox Show the hitboxes: bodies (green), limbs (yellow), blades (light blue), hits (red) /avalon_combat_debug Draw the hand movements and print every hit

docs.title: How Damage Works
docs.text:
1. The attacker's client checks limbs and blades every frame along the animation. A limb slower than MinSweepSpeed does not hit (wind-up and return of the strike).
  2. When a limb or a blade touches a ped's hitbox, the client reports it to the server.
  3. The server validates the hit (distance, maximum damage, attack unlocked), calculates damage and guard, and runs the hit handlers of other resources.

  4. Depending on AvalonCombat.DamageMode:

    • 'native' — the damage is applied to the ped's real health
    • 'external' — no damage: the server emits the avalon_combat:hit event for your own system (fake health bars, resistances)

    The victim still performs the reaction.

Formula: base damage (the weapon's if the blade hits, otherwise the style's damage) × the attack's mult × progression multiplier × outgoing multiplier, rounded. Then the guard's defence is subtracted.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
The configuration files are in config/:

File Contents config/config.lua General settings, combos, NPCs, sounds, damage, defence, input config/guard.lua The game's guards usable by name ('blade', 'unarmed') config/weapons.lua Right-hand weapons config/offhand.lua Left-hand weapons config/shields.lua Shields (one entry per color) config/styles/ Optional local styles and example.lua with every field explained

Editable files

The files in config/ (and config/styles/) are open: the rest of the resource is protected with Cfx Escrow. Everything is customised from there and through the exports.

docs.title: General Settings
docs.text: Option Default Description Debug false Enables the chat commands and /avalon_combat_debug (testing only) TargetRange 4.0 m: peds farther away are not checked LockRange / LockCone 3.0 / 45 An attack turns toward the nearest ped within these meters and degrees AttackTowardsCamera true The player's attacks (and R's pair) go where the camera points: the character turns there as each attack starts. false: where the character faces LockOnRange 12.0 m: lock-on radius with E MinSweepSpeed 2.0 m/s: a slower limb does not hit SkipStart 0.10 Initial part of every attack that is ignored Rehit 0.45 s before the same attack can hit the same target again MaxHitDamage 200 The server rejects hits above this damage MaxHitDistance 6.0 The server rejects hits on players farther away than this PairRange 3.5 m: maximum grab distance of a paired attack HitboxScale / HitboxPad 1.0 / 0.0 Enlarges blade hitboxes (to hit more easily) SoundVolume 0.35 Volume of the audio files DamageMode 'native' 'native' or 'external' (see above)

docs.title: Combos
docs.text:
AvalonCombat.ComboWindow = 0.45 -- from this phase of the attack, a press queues the next hit
AvalonCombat.ComboCancel = 1.0  -- phase at which the queued hit starts (1.0 = at the end of the animation)
AvalonCombat.ComboReset = 0.8   -- s: after a pause longer than this the combo restarts from the first hit

docs.title: Input Mode
docs.text:
AvalonCombat.InputMode = 'combo' -- 'combo' | 'keys'
AvalonCombat.Keys = { SimulWindow = 0.08, SequenceWindow = 0.6, DirAbove = 0.5 }
  • 'combo': each key performs the next hit of its chain (light, heavy, special)
  • 'keys': like in a fighting game, keys perform the style's moves. You can combine keys pressed together ('light+heavy'), a direction ('F+heavy': forward + heavy) or sequences ({ 'light', 'light', 'heavy' })

Each player can have a different one with the SetInputMode export.

docs.title: Guard and Parry
docs.text:
AvalonCombat.Defence = {
    Mode = 'always',      -- 'always' | 'timed' | 'stamina' | 'points'
    ParryWindow = 0.25,   -- s: guard raised within this time of the hit = parry
    StaminaCost = 15.0,   -- 'stamina': stamina removed per parried hit
    Points = 100, PointsRegen = 10, PointsCost = 20, -- 'points': guard points
    BreakTime = 1.5,      -- s without guard after it breaks
    Block = { percent = 0.75, flat = 0 }, -- base defence of the guard
}
Mode When the guard stops a hit always Always, damage reduced by the defence timed Only within ParryWindow of raising it, otherwise the hit lands in full stamina Always, every hit costs stamina; when stamina runs out the guard breaks points Always, every hit costs guard points (GetGuard / SetGuard exports); at zero it breaks

A parry cancels the damage and makes the attacker stagger. Defence = damage × (1 - percent) - flat, never below zero. A wielded shield replaces the guard's defence with its own; the one given with the SetDefence export is added on top.

docs.title: Sounds
docs.text:
Every sound has a name in AvalonCombat.Sounds. Styles, attacks, weapons and paired attacks use those names: a single name, a list to pick one from at random, or { light = ..., heavy = ..., special = ... } per chain.

AvalonCombat.Sounds = {
    punch = { file = melee('punch', 11) },                 -- file in sounds/ (.wav .ogg .mp3)
    my_roar = { file = 'roar.ogg', volume = 0.8, range = 40 },
    beast_roar = { set = 'LSHNT_sounds', name = 'ROAR' },  -- game sound
}

The included melee sounds are the game's own, extracted into sounds/melee_*.wav.

Sound at the right moment

soundAt starts the sound at a precise phase of the animation: 0.35 = at 35% of the clip. It works for attacks, for paired attacks and for the style's movements (soundAt = { leap = 0.27, dodge = 0.15 }). Without soundAt the sound starts at the first fast movement (attacks) or immediately.

docs.title: Body Hitboxes
docs.text: AvalonCombat.BodyHitbox lists the capsules every ped is hit on ({ bone from, bone to, radius }): head, chest, abdomen, arms and legs. An animal without those bones becomes a 0.4 m sphere. /avalon_hitbox shows them in game.

docs.title: Weapons and Shields
docs.text:
Weapons and shields are your server's own: model is the name of any streamed prop, as long as its resource is started. The shipped config lists the models of avalon_weapons_rdr2 and avalon_shields_tint: replace them with yours or add more.

Each entry in config/weapons.lua, config/offhand.lua and config/shields.lua is a wielded model:

AvalonCombat.Weapons.xur_katana = {
    model = 'weapon_xur_katana',
    bone = 'SKEL_R_Hand',                         -- bone it is attached to
    offset = vector3(0.075, 0.00, -0.03),         -- m
    rot = vector3(-90.0, 0.0, 0.0),               -- degrees
    damage = 25,                                  -- per blade hit, × the attack's mult
    sounds = { swing = 'blade_swipe', hit = { 'machete_slash', 'blade_flesh' } },
    blade = { from = vector3(0, 0, 0.12), to = vector3(0, 0, 1.05), radius = 0.08 }, -- blade hitbox
}
Field Description model Model archetype: any streamed prop tint Optional: color index (shields have one entry per color) bone, offset, rot Where it sits in the hand. Adjust it in game with /avalon_weapon_offset, which prints the line to copy damage Damage per blade hit sounds The blade's swing and hit blade Blade capsule in model space: it hits in place of the hand cast Staffs only: the point spells will come from defence Shields only: { percent, flat } in place of the guard's

docs.title: Weapons from the inventory
docs.text:
Style and weapon are separate: every style can wield any weapon in the config, so several styles can share the same weapon. From your script pick the weapon (for example from the item used) and the style (for example from the class), for players and NPCs:

-- server: the item picks the weapon, the class the style
local ItemWeapons = { katana_item = 'xur_katana', machete_item = 'xur_machete2' }

RegisterNetEvent('my_inventory:useWeapon', function(item)
    local src = source
    local weapon = ItemWeapons[item]
    if not weapon then return end
    -- different styles with the same weapon
    local style = MyClasses.IsMaster(src) and 'katana3' or 'katana'
    exports.avalon_combat:SetStyle(src, style, { weapon = weapon, shield = false })
end)

-- only the weapon, the style stays
exports.avalon_combat:SetHeld(src, 'weapon', 'xur_machete2')

-- an NPC: the same with { net = netId }
local net = exports.avalon_combat:SpawnFighter('katana', coords, 90.0, { weapon = 'xur_machete2' })
exports.avalon_combat:SetStyle({ net = net }, 'katana4', { weapon = 'xur_machete2' })

docs.title: Creating a Style
docs.text:
A style can be written in two places:

In the animation packIn config/styles

The way the Avalon packs do it. Next to the pack's fxmanifest.lua put avalon_combat.lua:

local Styles = {}

Styles.mystyle = {
    dict = 'avalon@anims@mystyle',
    -- ...
    block = 'blade',   -- a pack names the game's guard as a string
}

exports('CombatStyles', function() return Styles end)

and in the pack's fxmanifest.lua:

avalon_combat_styles 'yes'
shared_script 'avalon_combat.lua'

A config/styles/mystyle.lua file inside avalon_combat:

AvalonCombat.Styles.mystyle = {
    dict = 'avalon@anims@mystyle',
    -- ...
}

A style written here wins over a pack's style with the same name: to modify a pack's style, copy it here.

config/styles/example.lua contains a complete style, commented field by field.

docs.title: Style Fields
docs.text: Field Description dict Animation dictionary (.ycd) damage Damage of a body hit (punches, kicks, claws) idle Looping animation when standing still weapon / offhand / shield What it wields (keys of Weapons, Offhand, Shields) hands The limbs that hit: { bone from, bone to, reach } reach / radius Reach beyond the last bone and thickness of the limbs (m) light / heavy / special The combo chains: lists of attacks moves The moves of the 'keys' mode sounds swing, hit, knockdown, block, leap, dodge, boost, float soundAt Phase at which the movement sounds start block Guard: { start, loop, stop, hit } with its own clips, or 'blade' / 'unarmed'. Without block the style cannot parry stagger / knockdown Hit reaction clips move Special movement: kind = 'runner' (sprint, dodge, leap) or kind = 'flyer' (flight, boost) pairs Paired attacks

docs.title: An Attack
docs.text:
light = {
    { clip = 'attack@slash1', mult = 1.0 },
    { clip = 'attack@slash2', mult = 1.25, knockdown = true, soundAt = 0.35 },
},
Field Description clip The animation mult Damage multiplier knockdown The victim falls react The victim reacts even if it is not a special attack sound / soundAt The attack's own sound and the phase it starts at keepTurn The ped stays turned the way the animation leaves it locked Locked until progression unlocks it (SetAttackEnabled) id Attack name for the exports (default: the clip)

docs.title: Paired Attack
docs.text:
pairs = {
    bite = { att = 'bite@att', vic = 'bite@vic', x = 0.5, y = 2.8, yaw = 196,
             mult = 4.0, damageAt = 0.45, sound = 'beast_roar', soundAt = 0.2 },
},

att / vic are the clips of the attacker and of the victim. x, y and yaw say where the victim stands relative to the attacker (m, degrees). damageAt is the phase at which the damage lands. Adjust it in game with /avalon_pair_offset.

Animation movement

The clips of the Avalon packs move the ped along their own motion (steps, dashes, leaps). Clips from third-party packs play in place.

docs.title: NPC Fighters
docs.text:
An NPC fighter is a networked ped that fights on its own with a style: it looks for a target, approaches, attacks in combos, parries, dodges, leaps or flies.

  • Team: players are 'player'. An NPC attacks players (unless its team is 'player') and NPCs of other teams, never ordinary peds.
  • Skill: AvalonCombat.Npc in config/config.lua holds the default values (aggression radius, attack distance, parry chance, dodge, paired attack...). Each NPC can change some of them with opts.skill.
-- server
local net = exports.avalon_combat:SpawnFighter('werewolf', vector3(-300.0, 790.0, 118.0), 90.0, {
    team = 'bandits',
    health = 400,
    scale = 1.5,
    skill = { BlockChance = 0.6, Weights = { heavy = 0.6 } },
})

-- later
exports.avalon_combat:StopFighter(net)
opts Description model Ped model (default AvalonCombat.Npc.Model) weapon / offhand / shield What it wields: config keys (default: the style's; false = empty hand). A key that does not exist makes the spawn fail team Team (default 'npc') health Health scale NPC size (1 = normal, from 0.2 to 5). Hitboxes, hit reach, animation movement and combat distances grow with it skill Only the AvalonCombat.Npc values that change

A player is required

SpawnFighter creates the ped on the client of the player closest to the coordinates: with an empty server it returns nil.

docs.title: Progression (levels and skills)
docs.text: avalon_combat has no level or skill system: that belongs to your server. The script only gives you the tools to decide, for each player or NPC fighter, which attacks it can use and how strong it is. Your system calls the exports, avalon_combat applies them.

docs.title: Which attacks it can use
docs.text:
• Every attack is available unless its entry in the style has locked = true: then it starts locked for everyone.
  • SetAttackEnabled(target, style, attackId, true | false) unlocks or locks an attack for that fighter and that style. It overrides the config's locked.
  • attackId is the attack's id, otherwise its clip name. For a paired attack it is its key in pairs. GetAttacks(style) lists every attack of a style with its id, chain and locked.
  • The combo chains (light, heavy, special) and the moves of the 'keys' mode are separate entries with separate ids: if your server uses both modes, unlock both.
  • A locked attack is skipped: in the combo the button moves on to the next available attack of the chain (none available: the button does nothing); in the 'keys' mode the move is never picked; R does not start the paired attack. NPCs only use their available attacks.
  • The server drops the hits of a locked attack: a modified client still cannot use it.

docs.title: How strong it is
docs.text:
Export Effect SetAttackMultiplier(target, style, attackId, m) Multiplies one attack's damage SetOutgoingMultiplier(target, m) Multiplies all of its damage SetDefence(target, { percent, flat }) Its own defence, added to the guard's or the shield's SetMaxGuard(target, max) Maximum guard points ('points' mode) SetInputMode(target, 'combo' \| 'keys') The fighter's input mode SetStyle(target, style, weapons) · SetHeld(target, slot, key) Style and weapons of players and NPCs (for example from their class or inventory)

Every Set... has a matching Get... to read the current value.

Nothing is saved

Progression lives in memory: when the player leaves (or an NPC stops) it goes back to the config values. Saving it is your system's job, sending it again on every join, for example when the character is loaded.

-- server: your level system
local Unlocks = { -- minimum level per attack, per style
    katana = { ['combo@a03@rm'] = 5, ['combo@a04@rm'] = 10, ['combo@d03@rm'] = 15 },
}

local function applyProgress(src, level)
    for style, attacks in pairs(Unlocks) do
        for attackId, minLevel in pairs(attacks) do
            exports.avalon_combat:SetAttackEnabled(src, style, attackId, level >= minLevel)
        end
    end
    exports.avalon_combat:SetOutgoingMultiplier(src, 1.0 + level * 0.02) -- +2% damage per level
end

AddEventHandler('mylevels:loaded', applyProgress)  -- character loaded
AddEventHandler('mylevels:levelUp', applyProgress) -- new level

docs.title: Available Exports
docs.text: A target is a player's server ID or { net = netId } for an NPC fighter.

docs.title: Server-Side Exports
docs.text: Export Description SetStyle(target, style \| nil, weapons) Puts the fighter in combat with that style. weapons: { weapon, offhand, shield }, each a config key, false for an empty hand, missing for the style's own. nil takes a player out of combat (an NPC is removed with StopFighter) GetStyle(target) The fighter's current style SetHeld(target, slot, key \| nil) Weapon ('weapon', 'offhand') or shield ('shield') in hand, keeping the style GetHeld(target) { slot = key } SpawnFighter(style, coords, heading, opts) Create an NPC fighter, returns the net id StopFighter(net) Remove an NPC fighter AddHitHandler(fn) / RemoveHitHandler(id) Function called on every hit (see below) GetDamageMode() 'native' or 'external' React(target, what) Make the target perform 'stagger', 'knockdown' or 'death' SetAttackEnabled(target, style, attackId, on) / IsAttackEnabled(...) Unlock or lock an attack for that fighter SetAttackMultiplier(target, style, attackId, m) / GetAttackMultiplier(...) An attack's multiplier SetOutgoingMultiplier(target, m) / GetOutgoingMultiplier(target) Multiplier on all of its damage SetDefence(target, { percent, flat }) / GetDefence(target) Own defence, added to the guard's GetGuard / SetGuard / GetMaxGuard / SetMaxGuard Guard points ('points' mode) SetInputMode(target, 'combo' \| 'keys' \| nil) / GetInputMode(target) The fighter's input mode GetStyles() All loaded styles GetAttacks(style) { { id, chain, clip, mult, locked, input } } GetWeapon(key) / GetShield(key) Config entry

docs.title: The Hit (hit)
docs.text:
Hit handlers and the avalon_combat:hit event receive this table:

Field Description mode 'native' or 'external' attacker { kind = 'player' \| 'fighter', src, net, style, team } victim { kind = 'player' \| 'fighter' \| 'ped', src, net, style } attack { id, chain, clip, mult, knockdown, react } (chain: light, heavy, special, moves, pair) weapon { slot, key, data } if a blade hit, otherwise nil base The weapon's or style's damage attackMult, progressMult, outgoingMult The three multipliers damage Damage before the guard guard { blocked, parried, broken, percent, flat, cost } final Damage after the guard (the one applied in 'native') direction { x, y } from the attacker to the victim

Handlers run after the guard is calculated. A handler returns the modified hit, nil to leave it as is, or false to cancel it. The handlers of a resource that stops are removed automatically.

-- server: resistances and levels
exports.avalon_combat:AddHitHandler(function(hit)
    if hit.victim.kind == 'player' and HasSilverArmor(hit.victim.src) and hit.attacker.style == 'werewolf' then
        hit.final = hit.final * 0.5 -- rounded by the server after the handlers
        return hit
    end
end)

-- server: DamageMode = 'external', health handled by your own system
AddEventHandler('avalon_combat:hit', function(hit)
    if hit.victim.kind ~= 'player' then return end
    local hp = MyHealth.Remove(hit.victim.src, hit.final)
    if hp <= 0 then exports.avalon_combat:React(hit.victim.src, 'death') end
end)

Server events (AddEventHandler, they receive the hit): avalon_combat:hit ('external' mode), avalon_combat:blocked, avalon_combat:parried, avalon_combat:guardBroken.

docs.text:

Local event avalon_combat:onHurt (ped, info, attacker): on every hit taken by a ped handled by this client, for an HUD.

-- client: health bar and damage numbers
AddEventHandler('avalon_combat:onHurt', function(ped, info, attacker)
    if ped ~= PlayerPedId() then return end
    if info.parried then
        ShowText('PARRY!')
    elseif info.blocked then
        ShowText(('-%d (blocked)'):format(info.damage))
    else
        ShowText(('-%d'):format(info.damage))
    end
end)

-- client: no combat while the menu is open
exports.avalon_combat:SetCombatEnabled(false)

docs.title: avalon_mounts
docs.text:
Script for rideable creatures in FiveM. Players can summon, ride, and manage fantastical creatures (dragons, griffins, pegasi, horses, alpacas) via commands or inventory items.

Version: 1.0 | Author: Mino

docs.title: Dependencies
docs.text: Resource Required Notes ox_lib ✅ Notifications and utilities ox_inventory ❌ Only if CONFIG.items = true ox_fuel ❌ Auto-maintains fuel at max qbx_core ❌ QBox keys integration qbx_vehiclekeys ❌ QBox keys integration

docs.title: Basic Usage (Commands)
docs.text: When CONFIG.command = true, players can summon and dismiss creatures directly from chat — no items or extra scripts needed.

docs.title: Summon a creature
docs.text:
/mount <name> <variant>
Parameter Type Description name string Creature type (see table below) variant number Variant number (1, 2, 3...)

Examples:

/mount necrodragon 1
/mount griffon 2
/mount pegaso 1
/mount horse 3
/mount alpaca 1

docs.title: Dismiss the creature
docs.text:
/delMount

Removes the currently summoned creature from the world.

docs.title: In-Game Controls
docs.text:
Once a creature is summoned:

Action Default Key Config Mount / Dismount E CONFIG.keyMount = 51 Dismiss creature H CONFIG.keyDelete = 74 Toggle fly mode X CONFIG.keyFlymode = 73

Changing keys

Edit the numeric values in config.lua. Codes correspond to FiveM control codes.

docs.title: Available Creatures
docs.text: Creature Command Variants Can Fly Necrodragon /mount necrodragon 5 (1–5) ✅ Griffon /mount griffon 3 (1–3) ✅ Pegaso /mount pegaso 3 (1–3) ✅ Horse /mount horse 3 (1–3) ❌ Alpaca /mount alpaca 3 (1–3) ❌

docs.title: General Settings
docs.text: Option Type Default Description CONFIG.command boolean true Enable /mount and /delMount commands CONFIG.commandName string "mount" Summon command name CONFIG.delCommand string "delMount" Dismiss command name CONFIG.items boolean true Enable item-based spawning (requires ox_inventory) CONFIG.invincible boolean false Make creature invincible CONFIG.maxrangedespawn number 200.0 Distance before creature auto-despawns CONFIG.timeForSpawnAfterDeaths number 10000 Wait time (ms) to summon after dying

docs.title: Flight System
docs.text:
CONFIG.flyWithTime = false   -- false = unlimited flight
CONFIG.flyTimeMax  = 60000   -- ms of flight (only if flyWithTime = true)
CONFIG.flyCooldown = 60000   -- ms cooldown before flying again

docs.title: Max Speed
docs.text:
Internal multiplier — test and calibrate on your server.

CONFIG.MaxSpeed = {
    ["necrodragon"] = 100.0,
    ["griffon"]     = 50.0,
    ["pegaso"]      = 70.0,
    ["alpaca"]      = 50.0,
    ["horse"]       = 70.0,
}

docs.title: API — Client-Side
docs.text:
Returns the API object with all public functions.

local MountsAPI = exports['avalon_mounts']:API()

docs.title: Functions
docs.text: Function Description MountsAPI.spawn(name, color) Summon a creature MountsAPI.despawn() Dismiss the active creature MountsAPI.isSpawned() true if a creature is summoned MountsAPI.isOnMount() true if player is mounted MountsAPI.getVehicle() Returns the creature vehicle entity MountsAPI.getData(model) Config data for a specific creature MountsAPI.getAllData() Data for all creatures MountsAPI.getBlacklist(vehicle) Check if a vehicle is blacklisted MountsAPI.deleteEnt(ent) Delete a specific entity MountsAPI.playAnimation(prop, anim, dict, loop) Play animation on the creature MountsAPI.syncInvisible(ent, bool) Sync visibility across all clients MountsAPI.syncHair(ent, head) Sync head/hair variant

docs.title: Example
docs.text:
local MountsAPI = exports['avalon_mounts']:API()

-- Summon griffon variant 2
MountsAPI.spawn("griffon", 2)

-- Check if player is mounted
if MountsAPI.isOnMount() then
    print("Player is riding a creature")
end

-- Get creature position
local mount = MountsAPI.getVehicle()
if mount then
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(mount)
end

-- Dismiss
MountsAPI.despawn()

docs.title: avalon_party
docs.text:
MMORPG-style party system for FiveM. Create groups with a real-time HUD, customizable vital bars, ready check, shared waypoint, automatic spectator mode, map blips and head markers, target marking with symbols, and private instances (routing buckets).

Version: 1.0.0 | Author: Avalon | Framework: ESX / QBCore / QBox / Standalone

docs.title: Dependencies
docs.text: Resource Required ox_lib ✅ ox_target ✅

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
1. Copy the avalon_party/ folder into resources/
  2. Add the resource to server.cfg after ox_lib and ox_target
ensure ox_lib
ensure ox_target
ensure avalon_party

Framework

Detection is automatic: es_extended → ESX, qbx_core → QBox, qb-core → QBCore, otherwise standalone. Character names are read from the detected framework.

docs.title: Languages
docs.text:
Every string lives in locales/<code>.lua, one file per language. Shipped: English, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai.

-- config.lua (keep this line at the top of the file)
Config.locale = 'en'   -- en | it | pt | es | ru | zh | th
  • A missing key in a translation falls back to English automatically
  • Translations cover both the game notifications and the text inside the HUD
  • To add one: copy locales/en.lua, rename it (e.g. de.lua), translate the values, change Locales['en'] to Locales['de'] and set Config.locale = 'de'

Custom labels

Every label in Config.Bars, Config.Statuses and Config.TargetSymbols can be a Locale.* key (translated) or your own hardcoded string.

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
Command Argument Description /party — Open the party management menu /partyinvite [player id] Invite a player to the party /partyaccept — Accept a pending invite /partydecline — Decline a pending invite /partyleave — Leave the party /partydisband — Disband the party (leader only) /partykick [player id] Kick a member (leader only) /partytransfer [player id] Transfer leadership (leader only) /partyready — Start a ready check (leader only) /partywp — Share current waypoint (leader only)

Anyone can invite

You do not need a party first: the initial invite creates the group. Permissions (leader, member, existing party) are validated server-side anyway.

docs.title: Keybinds
docs.text:
Key Action F5 Open party management menu F1 Accept incoming invite F2 Decline incoming invite F3 Confirm "Ready" (ready check) F4 Confirm "Not Ready" (ready check) TAB Cycle nearby targets (must be enabled in the menu) CTRL (hold) Marking crosshair, leader only — right click on a ped opens the symbol picker ← → Switch spectated player while in spectator mode

Changing the keys

Defaults live in config.lua under Config.Keys. They are registered with lib.addKeybind, so every player can remap them from the FiveM key settings (Settings → Key Bindings → FiveM).

docs.title: ox_target interaction
docs.text: Aiming at another player shows the "Invite to Party" option (3 m range). Fastest way to invite someone without knowing their server ID.

docs.title: Party menu (F5)
docs.text:
The menu is a NUI screen and offers:

  • Member list with kick and leadership transfer (leader only)
  • Leave party / Disband party (leader only)
  • Start ready check and Share waypoint (leader only)
  • TAB targeting toggle and symbol marking toggle
  • HUD visibility: every bar and the status block can be toggled individually
  • World element visibility: map blips and head markers
  • HUD scale from 0.5 to 3.0

Settings persist

Menu choices are per player and stored in the NUI localStorage: no server traffic and no database table. They survive a game restart.

docs.title: General
docs.text:
Option Default Description Config.locale 'en' Language (en it pt es ru zh th) Config.maxPartySize 6 Maximum members per party Config.inviteExpiry 30000 ms before an invite expires Config.offlineGracePeriod 120000 ms a disconnected member keeps his slot Config.readyCheckTimeout 15000 Ready check duration in ms

Reconnecting

Within offlineGracePeriod a returning player is put back into his party. A leader is replaced right away, but gets the lead back on return.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
Config.Features = {
    distance   = true,  -- show distance (meters) on member cards
    readyCheck = true,  -- ready check system
    waypoint   = true,  -- shared waypoint from leader
    spectator  = true,  -- auto-spectator on death
    targetMark = true,  -- target marking with symbols
}

Turning a feature off also removes its commands, keybinds and menu entries.

docs.title: HUD
docs.text:
Config.UI = {
    position       = 'top-left',  -- 'top-left' | 'top-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'bottom-right'
    pickClick      = 'right',     -- mouse button to pick a member: 'right' | 'left'
    offsetX        = 20,
    offsetY        = 20,
    hudWidth       = 260,         -- card width in px, before scaling
    scale          = 1.0,         -- 1.0 = automatic (see below)
    showStatuses   = true,        -- show the status icon block
    updateInterval = 500,         -- ms between vitals refreshes
    criticalPct    = 20,          -- below this percentage a bar pulses red
}

Automatic scaling

Leaving scale = 1.0 lets the HUD size itself: 1.5 from 2560 px, 1.6 from 3440 px (ultrawide), 2.0 from 3840 px (4K). Any other value is used as-is. Players can still override it from the F5 menu.

docs.title: Health and stamina
docs.text:
Health and stamina never go through the server: every client reads them from the GTA natives for all streamed members. Out of streaming range (~200 m) the last known values are kept and flagged as stale.

Config.Health = {
    displayMode     = 'usable',  -- 'usable' | 'raw' | 'percent'
    syncMaxHealth   = true,      -- share max HP between clients (state bag)
    applyMaxToClone = true,      -- raise the HP ceiling of cloned peds on other clients
    autoDeadStatus  = true,      -- turn the 'dead' status on automatically at zero health
    deadStatusId    = 'dead',    -- status id used for death
}
displayMode What it shows usable 87/100 male, 62/75 female — health minus the death threshold raw 187/200 and 162/175 — native values, half bar on death percent 87/100 for everybody — same bar length for male and female

Custom maximums

GTA does not sync max health. With syncMaxHealth = false women show up at 75% on other HUDs and health upgrades stay invisible. With applyMaxToClone = false a 400 HP member is cut down to 200 on everybody else's screen.

docs.title: World elements
docs.text:
Config.World = {
    showBlips       = true,
    blipSprite      = 1,      -- 1 = standard player dot
    blipColorMember = 5,      -- yellow
    blipColorLeader = 28,     -- gold
    blipScale       = 0.75,

    showHeadMarker    = true,
    headMarkerDist    = 50.0,   -- max distance, GTA units
    headMarkerOffsetZ = 1.5,

    headMarker = {
        text  = '🛡',
        scale = 0.30,
        r = 255, g = 220, b = 60, a = 230,
    },
}

These are the defaults: each player can then turn blips and markers off from the F5 menu.

docs.title: Target marking
docs.text:
With Config.Features.targetMark = true the leader can put a symbol on a ped, visible to the whole party: hold CTRL, aim at the ped and right click to pick the symbol. TAB instead cycles nearby peds and is available to every member once enabled from the menu.

Config.TargetMark = {
    range         = 25.0,    -- TAB detection range
    oxTargetRange = 25.0,    -- ox_target range for "Mark Target"

    tabMarker    = { r = 255, g = 130, b = 0, a = 200 },
    tabRingType  = 1,        -- 1 = flat circle, 28 = thin, 36 = checkpoint
    tabShowRing  = true,
    tabArrowType = 27,       -- 27 = arrow down, 0 = arrow up
    tabShowArrow = true,

    ctrlIcon      = 'fa-solid fa-arrows-to-dot',  -- crosshair icon (any Font Awesome class)
    symbolScale   = 0.70,    -- symbol size above the ped
    symbolOffsetZ = 1.5,     -- height above the ped
    symbolMaxDist = 50.0,    -- past this the symbol is not drawn
    arrowScale    = 0.65,
    ringScale     = { x = 1.0, y = 1.0, z = 0.15 },
}

docs.title: Available symbols
docs.text:
ID Label Icon warning Warning ⚠️ target Target 🎯 attack Attack ❌ defend Defend 🛡️ heal Heal 💊 focus Focus ⭐

Add or remove them freely in Config.TargetSymbols.

docs.title: Vital Bars
docs.text:
Bars with builtin = true update themselves from the GTA natives (zero server traffic). Bars with builtin = false stay hidden until your script sends a value through the SetMemberBar export.

ID Label Builtin Color Visible by default health HP ✅ Red ✅ stamina Stamina ✅ Green ✅ mana Mana ❌ Blue ✅ shield Shield ❌ Grey ✅ rage Rage ❌ Orange ✅

docs.title: Adding a bar
docs.text:
-- config.lua, inside Config.Bars
{
    id         = 'energy',
    label      = 'Energy',      -- or a Locale.* key
    color      = '#f39c12',
    bgColor    = '#3d2200',
    icon       = '⚡',           -- emoji or a path under ui/dist/img/ (e.g. 'img/energy.png')
    defaultMax = 100,
    builtin    = false,         -- IMPORTANT: false for bars driven by external scripts
    visible    = true,          -- initial state of the menu toggle
},

Driving health or stamina yourself

Set builtin = false on the health (or stamina) bar: the resource stops writing to it and the value becomes whatever you send with SetMemberBar. Handy with wound systems or custom HP scales.

docs.title: Statuses
docs.text:
ID Label Icon combat In Combat ⚔️ poisoned Poisoned ☠️ buffed Buffed ✨ dead Dead 💀 afk AFK 💤

Every status is toggled with SetMemberStatus, except dead which is automatic as long as Config.Health.autoDeadStatus = true.

docs.title: Adding a status
docs.text:
-- config.lua, inside Config.Statuses
{ id = 'stunned', label = 'Stunned', icon = '💫', color = '#9b59b6', duration = 0 },

duration = 0 means the status stays on until you turn it off.

docs.title: IsInParty(source) → boolean
docs.text:
Check if a player is currently in a party.

local inParty = exports['avalon_party']:IsInParty(source)

if inParty then
    TriggerClientEvent('zone:denied', source, "Can't enter solo zones while in a party")
end

docs.title: GetPartyMembers(source) → table | nil
docs.text:
Returns a list of server IDs for all members of the player's party (leader included), or nil if he is not in one.

local members = exports['avalon_party']:GetPartyMembers(source)

if members then
    for _, memberId in ipairs(members) do
        -- give an item to every party member
        exports.ox_inventory:AddItem(memberId, 'health_potion', 1)
    end
end

docs.title: GetPartyLeader(source) → number | nil
docs.text:
Returns the server ID of the party leader.

local leader = exports['avalon_party']:GetPartyLeader(source)

if leader == source then
    print("This player is the party leader")
end

docs.title: SetMemberBar(source, barId, value, maxValue) → boolean
docs.text:
Update a bar in the HUD for a specific player, visible to all party members in real time. Returns false if the player is not in a party or the bar id is invalid.

Only bars with builtin = false

The call is rejected on bars flagged builtin = true, which the resource drives itself. To take over health or stamina, set builtin = false on that bar in config.lua.

-- Update mana bar after casting a spell
RegisterNetEvent('magic:castSpell')
AddEventHandler('magic:castSpell', function(manaCost)
    local src = source
    local newMana = math.max(0, GetPlayerMana(src) - manaCost)
    SetPlayerMana(src, newMana)

    exports['avalon_party']:SetMemberBar(src, 'mana', newMana, 100)
end)

-- Update shield on damage
RegisterNetEvent('combat:takeDamage')
AddEventHandler('combat:takeDamage', function(damage)
    local src = source
    local newShield = math.max(0, GetPlayerShield(src) - damage)
    exports['avalon_party']:SetMemberBar(src, 'shield', newShield, 100)
end)

docs.title: SetMemberStatus(source, statusId, active) → boolean
docs.text:
Show or hide a status icon on a member's HUD card.

-- Show "In Combat" when player fires
AddEventHandler('weaponDamageEvent', function(source)
    exports['avalon_party']:SetMemberStatus(source, 'combat', true)
    SetTimeout(5000, function()
        exports['avalon_party']:SetMemberStatus(source, 'combat', false)
    end)
end)

-- Show "Poisoned"
RegisterNetEvent('poison:apply')
AddEventHandler('poison:apply', function()
    exports['avalon_party']:SetMemberStatus(source, 'poisoned', true)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('poison:cure')
AddEventHandler('poison:cure', function()
    exports['avalon_party']:SetMemberStatus(source, 'poisoned', false)
end)

The dead status

With Config.Health.autoDeadStatus = true (default) death is handled by the resource. Set it to false to drive it from your own script.

docs.title: SetPartyBucket(source, bucket) → boolean
docs.text:
Move an entire party into a routing bucket (private instance). Useful for dungeons and events. The bucket sticks to the party: members who join later are moved in automatically, members who leave go back to bucket 0. Leadership is not required.

RegisterNetEvent('dungeon:enter')
AddEventHandler('dungeon:enter', function(dungeonId)
    local src = source
    local bucket = 1000 + dungeonId

    local ok = exports['avalon_party']:SetPartyBucket(src, bucket)
    if ok then
        TriggerClientEvent('dungeon:teleport', src, dungeonId)
    else
        TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', src, {
            type = 'error', description = 'You need a party to enter this dungeon!'
        })
    end
end)

-- Return to main world on exit
RegisterNetEvent('dungeon:exit')
AddEventHandler('dungeon:exit', function()
    exports['avalon_party']:SetPartyBucket(source, 0)
end)

docs.title: GetPartyBucket(source) → number
docs.text:
Get the current routing bucket of the party (0 = main world, also when the player is not in a party).

local bucket = exports['avalon_party']:GetPartyBucket(source)
print("Party is in bucket: " .. bucket)

docs.title: RequestMemberPick(mode, callbackEvent)
docs.text:
Activates member selection mode: the cursor appears over the party cards and the player clicks the member he wants. Useful for targeting heals, buffs, trades or abilities at a specific member.

  • mode: "self" → the event fires on the player who picked · "target" → the event fires on the member who was picked
  • callbackEvent: client event name (RegisterNetEvent) that receives the data

The callback receives a table:

Field Type Description id number Server ID of the picked member name string Character name bars table Server-side bars (mana, shield, …) — not health and stamina statuses table Active statuses isLeader boolean true if the picked member is the leader offline boolean true if he is disconnected but still in the party picker number Server ID of the player who started the pick

No callback on cancel

If the player presses ESC or you call CancelMemberPick(), the event is not fired. The mouse button used to click is set by Config.UI.pickClick. If the player is not in a party the call shows an error notification and does nothing.

-- Pick a member to heal, give up after 10 seconds
RegisterCommand('heal_ally', function()
    exports['avalon_party']:RequestMemberPick('self', 'healing:onTargetPicked')

    SetTimeout(10000, function()
        exports['avalon_party']:CancelMemberPick()  -- no-op if he already picked
    end)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('healing:onTargetPicked')
AddEventHandler('healing:onTargetPicked', function(member)
    if member.offline then return end
    TriggerServerEvent('healing:applyHeal', member.id, 50)
end)

-- mode 'target': the event fires on the picked member, not on the picker
RegisterCommand('giveitem', function()
    exports['avalon_party']:RequestMemberPick('target', 'myScript:itemOffered')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('myScript:itemOffered')
AddEventHandler('myScript:itemOffered', function(data)
    -- data.picker = the source of the player who started the pick
    print(('%s wants to give you an item'):format(data.picker))
end)

docs.title: CancelMemberPick()
docs.text:
Cancel the active member selection without picking anybody. No event is fired. The call is ignored if no pick is running.

exports['avalon_party']:CancelMemberPick()

docs.title: GetPartyTarget() → { ped, netId, source, isPlayer } | nil
docs.text:
Returns info about the ped currently selected through the TAB cycle. Available only with Config.Features.targetMark = true. source is nil when the ped is an NPC.

RegisterCommand('attack_target', function()
    local target = exports['avalon_party']:GetPartyTarget()
    if not target then
        lib.notify({ type='error', description='No target selected' })
        return
    end

    if target.isPlayer then
        TriggerServerEvent('combat:attackPlayer', target.source)
    else
        TriggerServerEvent('combat:attackNpc', target.netId)
    end
end)

Reference file

The resource ships with example_integration.lua. It is never loaded — it is a collection of ready-made snippets to copy into your own script.

docs.title: AvalonStudios Script Docs
docs.text:
Bienvenido a la documentación oficial de los scripts FiveM y RedM de AvalonStudios.

Aquí encontrarás la referencia completa de todos los scripts: configuración, exports disponibles y ejemplos de uso.

docs.title: Scripts FiveM
docs.text: Script Descripción Exports avalon_coltivation Sistema de cultivo de plantas ✅ avalon_dustman Trabajo de basurero (solo/grupo) ❌ avalon_electrician Trabajo de electricista con minijuegos ❌ avalon_lumberjack Trabajo de leñador con minijuego ❌ avalon_mining Trabajo de minero con minijuego ❌ avalon_mounts Criaturas montables (dragones, grifos, pegasos...) ✅ avalon_party Sistema de party MMORPG con HUD, barras vitales, mazmorras ✅ avalon_robbery Sistema de robo a tiendas ❌ avalon_trash Sistema de búsqueda en basura ❌

docs.title: Scripts RedM
docs.text: Script Descripción Exports avalon_combat Combate cuerpo a cuerpo con estilos, armas, parada, ataques emparejados y NPC ✅

docs.title: Dependencias Comunes (FiveM)
docs.text:
Todos los scripts FiveM requieren los siguientes recursos activos:

  • ox_lib — Librería base
  • ox_target — Sistema de interacciones
  • ox_inventory — Gestión de inventario
  • es_extended — Framework ESX

Consejo

Asegúrate de que todas las dependencias se inicien antes que los scripts Avalon en tu server.cfg.

Los scripts RedM son standalone: sus dependencias están en el resumen RedM.

docs.title: Cómo Usar los Exports
docs.text:
Los exports permiten que otros scripts llamen funciones de un script Avalon sin dependencias directas en el código.

ClientServer 
-- Llamar un export desde el lado cliente
exports['nombre-resource']:NombreFuncion(param1, param2)

-- Llamar un export desde el lado servidor
exports['nombre-resource']:NombreFuncion(param1, param2)

Importante

Los exports de cliente solo pueden llamarse desde scripts del lado cliente. Los exports de servidor solo pueden llamarse desde scripts del lado servidor.

Documentación por AvalonStudios — GitHub

docs.title: Resumen de Scripts RedM
docs.text: Los scripts RedM de AvalonStudios son standalone: no dependen de un framework y se conectan con los demás sistemas del servidor mediante exports y eventos.

docs.title: Lista de Scripts
docs.text: Script Versión Exports Client Exports Server Base de datos avalon_combat beta ✅ 10 ✅ 28 ❌

docs.title: Dependencias por Script
docs.text:
avalon_combat  → OneSync, paquetes de animación avalon_anims_*

Paquetes de animación

Los estilos de combate provienen de los paquetes de animación Avalon (avalon_anims_*): cada paquete aporta sus propios estilos y avalon_combat los carga por sí solo. Ver Estilos.

docs.title: avalon_combat
docs.text:
Sistema de combate cuerpo a cuerpo para RedM. Cada estilo (licántropo, vampiro, katana, espada y escudo, pugilista, magos...) usa las animaciones de los paquetes Avalon. Los golpes los calcula el script: en cada frame sigue manos, pies y hojas a lo largo de la animación y golpea a los peds que atraviesan. El daño pasa siempre por el servidor.

Incluye: combos ligeros y pesados, ataques emparejados (dos peds animados a la vez), parada y contraataque, armas y escudos empuñados, carrera, esquiva, salto y vuelo para las criaturas, NPC que combaten solos y exports para conectar niveles, habilidades, barras de vida y magias.

Versión: beta | Autor: Avalon | Juego: RedM | Framework: standalone

docs.title: Dependencias
docs.text:
Resource Obligatoria Para qué sirve OneSync ✅ NPC combatientes y parada (state bag) avalon_weapons_rdr2 ❌ Opcional: los modelos de armas de la config incluida. Sirven también las armas que ya tienes (Armas y escudos) avalon_shields_tint ❌ Opcional: los modelos de escudos de la config incluida. Sirven también los escudos que ya tienes Paquetes de animación avalon_anims_* ✅ al menos uno Las animaciones y los estilos (ver Estilos)

No se requiere ningún framework: el script trabaja sobre los peds y los jugadores. La conexión con inventarios, niveles o barras de vida se hace con los exports.

docs.title: Instalación
docs.text:
1. Copia la carpeta avalon_combat/ en resources/
  2. Inicia los paquetes de animación y los recursos de tus modelos de armas y escudos, luego el recurso:
# ... los recursos de tus armas y escudos
ensure avalon_anims_werewolf
ensure avalon_anims_vampire
ensure avalon_anims_ka_02
# ... los demás paquetes que uses
ensure avalon_combat

Orden de los paquetes

Un paquete iniciado después de avalon_combat (o reiniciado) se lee igualmente: sus estilos se añaden en cuanto arranca.

docs.title: Estilos
docs.text:
Los estilos provienen de los paquetes de animación. Cada paquete aporta un archivo avalon_combat.lua con sus propios estilos y lo declara en su fxmanifest.lua. avalon_combat los recoge por sí solo mediante el export CombatStyles del paquete.

Estilo Paquete Arma Guardia Extra werewolf avalon_anims_werewolf garras del juego (manos desnudas) carrera, esquiva, salto, ataques emparejados vampire avalon_anims_vampire garras propia vuelo, boost, ataques emparejados succube avalon_anims_succube garras del juego (manos desnudas) vuelo, boost, ataques emparejados katana katana1 katana3 katana4 avalon_anims_ka_02 _01 _03 _04 xur_katana del juego (hoja) sword sword2 sword3 avalon_anims_sw_01 _02 _03 xur_machete2 del juego (hoja) sword_shield sword_shield2 sword_shield3 avalon_anims_sns_01 _02 _03 swn2craft + escudo propia / propia / del juego twinsword avalon_anims_twinsword01 xur_katana2 en ambas manos del juego (hoja) hammer2h avalon_anims_hammer2h hammermoore del juego (hoja) orientalmonk avalon_anims_orientalmonk giga del juego (hoja) pugilist avalon_anims_p_01 manos desnudas del juego (manos desnudas) firemage mage witch wizard avalon_anims_firemage_01 _mage_01 _witch_01 _wizard manos / bastón del juego (manos desnudas)

Magias

Los estilos de mago por ahora golpean con las manos, con un alcance mayor (como lo haría el hechizo). Los bastones son solo visuales: el punto desde el que saldrán las magias se lee con el export client GetCastPoint().

Para escribir tu propio estilo mira Crear un estilo.

docs.title: Comandos y teclas
docs.text:
Solo con el debug activo

Todos los comandos de chat existen solo con AvalonCombat.Debug = true en config/config.lua: sirven para configurar y probar estilos, armas y NPC. En un servidor en producción deja Debug = false y pon a los jugadores en combate desde tu script con el export de servidor SetStyle. Las teclas funcionan siempre.

docs.title: Modo combate
docs.text:
Comando Descripción /avalon_combat <estilo> Entra en combate con ese estilo (sin argumento lista los estilos) /avalon_combat off Sale del combate Tecla Acción Clic izquierdo Combo ligero (pulsa de nuevo durante el ataque para el siguiente golpe) Clic derecho Combo pesado R Ataque emparejado sobre el ped de enfrente (los estilos que lo tienen) o combo especial CTRL (mantenido) Guardia E Fija al ped apuntado con la cámara (rombo rojo sobre la cabeza): los ataques y los ataques emparejados van hacia él. E de nuevo lo suelta Shift Carrera (licántropo) · vuelo (estilos voladores, en el aire) Alt Esquiva (licántropo) · boost (estilos voladores) Shift + Espacio Salto (licántropo) · despegue y aterrizaje (estilos voladores)

Quién reacciona a los golpes

Los golpes ligeros y pesados solo hacen daño. El combo especial, los ataques emparejados y los ataques con react = true también hacen tambalear o caer a la víctima.

docs.title: Comandos de prueba y ajuste
docs.text: Comando Descripción /avalon_attack <id> Ejecuta un ataque del estilo actual (id o nombre del clip) /avalon_pair [nombre] Ejecuta un ataque emparejado sobre el ped de enfrente /avalon_pair_offset <nombre> <x> <y> <yaw> Mueve a la víctima de un ataque emparejado (solo en este cliente) /avalon_weapon <nombre\|off> Cambia el arma de la mano derecha /avalon_offhand <nombre\|off> Cambia el arma de la mano izquierda /avalon_shield <nombre\|off> Cambia el escudo /avalon_weapon_offset <x y z rx ry rz> [hueso] Ajusta la posición del arma e imprime la línea para copiar en el config (también _offhand_offset, _shield_offset) /avalon_sound <nombre> Reproduce un sonido del config /avalon_sound_game <set> <nombre> [bank] Prueba cualquier sonido del juego /avalon_npc <estilo> [team] [modelo] [escala] Crea un NPC combatiente 4 m delante /avalon_npc_clear Borra los NPC creados por ti /avalon_npc_info Estado de los NPC combatientes a menos de 30 m /avalon_dummy [modelo] · /avalon_dummy_clear Maniquíes quietos para golpear /avalon_hitbox Muestra las hitbox: cuerpos (verde), miembros (amarillo), hojas (azul claro), golpes (rojo) /avalon_combat_debug Dibuja los movimientos de las manos e imprime cada golpe

docs.title: Cómo funciona el daño
docs.text:
1. El cliente de quien ataca comprueba en cada frame miembros y hojas a lo largo de la animación. Un miembro más lento que MinSweepSpeed no golpea (carga y retorno del golpe).
  2. Cuando un miembro o una hoja toca la hitbox de un ped, el cliente se lo comunica al servidor.
  3. El servidor verifica el golpe (distancia, daño máximo, ataque desbloqueado), calcula daño y guardia y ejecuta los hit handlers de los demás recursos.

  4. Según AvalonCombat.DamageMode:

    • 'native' — el daño va a la vida real del ped
    • 'external' — sin daño: el servidor emite el evento avalon_combat:hit para tu sistema (barras de vida simuladas, resistencias)

    La víctima ejecuta la reacción igualmente.

Fórmula: daño base (el del arma si golpea la hoja, si no el damage del estilo) × mult del ataque × multiplicador de progresión × multiplicador de salida, redondeado. Después se resta la defensa de la guardia.

docs.title: Configuración
docs.text:
Los archivos de configuración están en config/:

Archivo Contenido config/config.lua Ajustes generales, combos, NPC, sonidos, daño, defensa, input config/guard.lua Las guardias del juego utilizables por nombre ('blade', 'unarmed') config/weapons.lua Armas de la mano derecha config/offhand.lua Armas de la mano izquierda config/shields.lua Escudos (una entrada por color) config/styles/ Estilos locales opcionales y example.lua con todos los campos explicados

Archivos editables

Los archivos de config/ (y config/styles/) están abiertos: el resto del recurso está protegido con Cfx Escrow. Todo se personaliza desde ahí y con los exports.

docs.title: Ajustes generales
docs.text: Opción Por defecto Descripción Debug false Activa los comandos de chat y /avalon_combat_debug (solo para pruebas) TargetRange 4.0 m: los peds más lejanos no se comprueban LockRange / LockCone 3.0 / 45 Un ataque se orienta hacia el ped más cercano dentro de estos metros y grados AttackTowardsCamera true Los ataques del jugador (y el emparejado con R) van hacia donde apunta la cámara: el personaje se gira hacia allí al empezar cada ataque. false: hacia donde mira el personaje LockOnRange 12.0 m: radio de la fijación con E MinSweepSpeed 2.0 m/s: un miembro más lento no golpea SkipStart 0.10 Parte inicial de cada ataque ignorada Rehit 0.45 s antes de que el mismo ataque pueda volver a golpear al mismo objetivo MaxHitDamage 200 El servidor rechaza golpes por encima de este daño MaxHitDistance 6.0 El servidor rechaza golpes a jugadores más lejos que esto PairRange 3.5 m: distancia máxima de agarre de un ataque emparejado HitboxScale / HitboxPad 1.0 / 0.0 Agranda las hitbox de las hojas (para golpear con más facilidad) SoundVolume 0.35 Volumen de los archivos de audio DamageMode 'native' 'native' o 'external' (ver arriba)

docs.title: Combo
docs.text:
AvalonCombat.ComboWindow = 0.45 -- desde esta fase del ataque, una pulsación pone en cola el siguiente golpe
AvalonCombat.ComboCancel = 1.0  -- fase en la que sale el golpe en cola (1.0 = al final de la animación)
AvalonCombat.ComboReset = 0.8   -- s: pasada esta pausa el combo vuelve al primer golpe

docs.title: Modo de input
docs.text:
AvalonCombat.InputMode = 'combo' -- 'combo' | 'keys'
AvalonCombat.Keys = { SimulWindow = 0.08, SequenceWindow = 0.6, DirAbove = 0.5 }
  • 'combo': cada tecla ejecuta el siguiente golpe de su cadena (light, heavy, special)
  • 'keys': como en un juego de lucha, las teclas ejecutan los moves del estilo. Se combinan teclas pulsadas a la vez ('light+heavy'), una dirección ('F+heavy': adelante + pesado) o secuencias ({ 'light', 'light', 'heavy' })

Cada jugador puede tener uno distinto con el export SetInputMode.

docs.title: Guardia y parada
docs.text:
AvalonCombat.Defence = {
    Mode = 'always',      -- 'always' | 'timed' | 'stamina' | 'points'
    ParryWindow = 0.25,   -- s: guardia levantada dentro de este tiempo desde el golpe = parada
    StaminaCost = 15.0,   -- 'stamina': stamina restada por golpe parado
    Points = 100, PointsRegen = 10, PointsCost = 20, -- 'points': puntos de guardia
    BreakTime = 1.5,      -- s sin guardia después de que se rompa
    Block = { percent = 0.75, flat = 0 }, -- defensa base de la guardia
}
Mode Cuándo la guardia detiene un golpe always Siempre, daño reducido por la defensa timed Solo dentro de ParryWindow desde que se levanta, si no el golpe entra completo stamina Siempre, cada golpe cuesta stamina; al acabarse la stamina la guardia se rompe points Siempre, cada golpe cuesta puntos de guardia (exports GetGuard / SetGuard); a cero se rompe

Una parada anula el daño y hace tambalear a quien ataca. Defensa = daño × (1 - percent) - flat, nunca por debajo de cero. Un escudo empuñado sustituye la defensa de la guardia por la suya; la dada con el export SetDefence se suma.

docs.title: Sonidos
docs.text:
Cada sonido tiene un nombre en AvalonCombat.Sounds. Estilos, ataques, armas y ataques emparejados usan esos nombres: un nombre, una lista de la que elegir uno al azar, o { light = ..., heavy = ..., special = ... } por cadena.

AvalonCombat.Sounds = {
    punch = { file = melee('punch', 11) },                 -- archivo en sounds/ (.wav .ogg .mp3)
    my_roar = { file = 'roar.ogg', volume = 0.8, range = 40 },
    beast_roar = { set = 'LSHNT_sounds', name = 'ROAR' },  -- sonido del juego
}

Los sonidos cuerpo a cuerpo incluidos son los del juego, extraídos en sounds/melee_*.wav.

Sonido en el momento justo

soundAt hace que el sonido empiece en una fase precisa de la animación: 0.35 = al 35% del clip. Vale para los ataques, para los ataques emparejados y para los movimientos del estilo (soundAt = { leap = 0.27, dodge = 0.15 }). Sin soundAt el sonido empieza en el primer movimiento rápido (ataques) o de inmediato.

docs.title: Hitbox del cuerpo
docs.text: AvalonCombat.BodyHitbox enumera las cápsulas sobre las que se golpea a cada ped ({ hueso desde, hueso hasta, radio }): cabeza, tórax, abdomen, brazos y piernas. Un animal sin esos huesos se convierte en una esfera de 0.4 m. /avalon_hitbox las muestra en el juego.

docs.title: Armas y escudos
docs.text:
Las armas y los escudos son los de tu servidor: model es el nombre de cualquier prop en stream, siempre que su recurso esté iniciado. La config incluida lista los modelos de avalon_weapons_rdr2 y avalon_shields_tint: sustitúyelos por los tuyos o añade otros.

Cada entrada de config/weapons.lua, config/offhand.lua y config/shields.lua es un modelo empuñado:

AvalonCombat.Weapons.xur_katana = {
    model = 'weapon_xur_katana',
    bone = 'SKEL_R_Hand',                         -- hueso al que está unida
    offset = vector3(0.075, 0.00, -0.03),         -- m
    rot = vector3(-90.0, 0.0, 0.0),               -- grados
    damage = 25,                                  -- por golpe de hoja, × mult del ataque
    sounds = { swing = 'blade_swipe', hit = { 'machete_slash', 'blade_flesh' } },
    blade = { from = vector3(0, 0, 0.12), to = vector3(0, 0, 1.05), radius = 0.08 }, -- hitbox de la hoja
}
Campo Descripción model Arquetipo del modelo: cualquier prop en stream tint Opcional: índice del color (los escudos tienen una entrada por color) bone, offset, rot Dónde se sostiene en la mano. Se ajusta en el juego con /avalon_weapon_offset, que imprime la línea para copiar damage Daño por golpe de hoja sounds swing y hit de la hoja blade Cápsula de la hoja en el espacio del modelo: golpea en lugar de la mano cast Solo bastones: el punto desde el que saldrán las magias defence Solo escudos: { percent, flat } en lugar de la de la guardia

docs.title: Armas desde el inventario
docs.text:
El estilo y el arma están separados: cada estilo puede empuñar cualquier arma de la config, así que varios estilos pueden usar la misma arma. Desde tu script eliges el arma (por ejemplo desde el item usado) y el estilo (por ejemplo desde la clase), para jugadores y NPC:

-- servidor: el item elige el arma, la clase el estilo
local ItemWeapons = { katana_item = 'xur_katana', machete_item = 'xur_machete2' }

RegisterNetEvent('my_inventory:useWeapon', function(item)
    local src = source
    local weapon = ItemWeapons[item]
    if not weapon then return end
    -- estilos distintos con la misma arma
    local style = MyClasses.IsMaster(src) and 'katana3' or 'katana'
    exports.avalon_combat:SetStyle(src, style, { weapon = weapon, shield = false })
end)

-- solo el arma, el estilo se queda
exports.avalon_combat:SetHeld(src, 'weapon', 'xur_machete2')

-- un NPC: lo mismo con { net = netId }
local net = exports.avalon_combat:SpawnFighter('katana', coords, 90.0, { weapon = 'xur_machete2' })
exports.avalon_combat:SetStyle({ net = net }, 'katana4', { weapon = 'xur_machete2' })

docs.title: Crear un estilo
docs.text:
Un estilo se puede escribir en dos lugares:

En el paquete de animaciónEn config/styles

La forma usada por los paquetes Avalon. Junto al fxmanifest.lua del paquete pon avalon_combat.lua:

local Styles = {}

Styles.mystyle = {
    dict = 'avalon@anims@mystyle',
    -- ...
    block = 'blade',   -- un paquete nombra la guardia del juego como cadena
}

exports('CombatStyles', function() return Styles end)

y en el fxmanifest.lua del paquete:

avalon_combat_styles 'yes'
shared_script 'avalon_combat.lua'

Un archivo config/styles/mystyle.lua dentro de avalon_combat:

AvalonCombat.Styles.mystyle = {
    dict = 'avalon@anims@mystyle',
    -- ...
}

Un estilo escrito aquí gana sobre el de un paquete con el mismo nombre: para modificar un estilo de un paquete, cópialo aquí.

config/styles/example.lua contiene un estilo completo, comentado campo por campo.

docs.title: Campos de un estilo
docs.text: Campo Descripción dict Diccionario de las animaciones (.ycd) damage Daño de un golpe del cuerpo (puñetazos, patadas, garras) idle Animación en bucle en reposo weapon / offhand / shield Qué empuña (claves de Weapons, Offhand, Shields) hands Los miembros que golpean: { hueso desde, hueso hasta, alcance } reach / radius Alcance más allá del último hueso y grosor de los miembros (m) light / heavy / special Las cadenas del combo: listas de ataques moves Los movimientos del modo 'keys' sounds swing, hit, knockdown, block, leap, dodge, boost, float soundAt Fase en la que salen los sonidos de los movimientos block Guardia: { start, loop, stop, hit } con clips propios, o 'blade' / 'unarmed'. Sin block el estilo no para stagger / knockdown Clips de reacción a los golpes move Movimiento especial: kind = 'runner' (carrera, esquiva, salto) o kind = 'flyer' (vuelo, boost) pairs Ataques emparejados

docs.title: Un ataque
docs.text:
light = {
    { clip = 'attack@slash1', mult = 1.0 },
    { clip = 'attack@slash2', mult = 1.25, knockdown = true, soundAt = 0.35 },
},
Campo Descripción clip La animación mult Multiplicador del daño knockdown La víctima cae react La víctima reacciona aunque no sea un ataque especial sound / soundAt Sonido propio del ataque y fase en la que sale keepTurn El ped se queda orientado como lo deja la animación locked Bloqueado hasta que la progresión lo desbloquea (SetAttackEnabled) id Nombre del ataque para los exports (por defecto: el clip)

docs.title: Ataque emparejado
docs.text:
pairs = {
    bite = { att = 'bite@att', vic = 'bite@vic', x = 0.5, y = 2.8, yaw = 196,
             mult = 4.0, damageAt = 0.45, sound = 'beast_roar', soundAt = 0.2 },
},

att / vic son los clips de quien ataca y de la víctima. x, y y yaw indican dónde está la víctima respecto a quien ataca (m, grados). damageAt es la fase en la que llega el daño. Se ajusta en el juego con /avalon_pair_offset.

Movimiento de las animaciones

Los clips de los paquetes Avalon desplazan al ped según su propio movimiento (pasos, sprints, saltos). Los clips de paquetes de terceros se reproducen en el sitio.

docs.title: NPC combatientes
docs.text:
Un NPC combatiente es un ped de red que combate solo con un estilo: busca un objetivo, se acerca, ataca en combo, para, esquiva, salta o vuela.

  • Team: los jugadores son 'player'. Un NPC ataca a los jugadores (a menos que su team sea 'player') y a los NPC de otros teams, nunca a los peds normales.
  • Habilidades: AvalonCombat.Npc en config/config.lua contiene los valores por defecto (radio de agresión, distancia de ataque, probabilidad de parada, esquiva, ataque emparejado...). Cada NPC puede cambiar algunos con opts.skill.
-- server
local net = exports.avalon_combat:SpawnFighter('werewolf', vector3(-300.0, 790.0, 118.0), 90.0, {
    team = 'bandits',
    health = 400,
    scale = 1.5,
    skill = { BlockChance = 0.6, Weights = { heavy = 0.6 } },
})

-- más tarde
exports.avalon_combat:StopFighter(net)
opts Descripción model Modelo del ped (por defecto AvalonCombat.Npc.Model) weapon / offhand / shield Lo que empuña: claves de la config (por defecto: las del estilo; false = mano vacía). Una clave que no existe hace fallar la creación team Team (por defecto 'npc') health Vida scale Tamaño del NPC (1 = normal, de 0.2 a 5). Con él crecen las hitbox, el alcance de los golpes, el movimiento de las animaciones y las distancias de combate skill Solo los valores de AvalonCombat.Npc que cambian

Se necesita un jugador

SpawnFighter crea el ped en el cliente del jugador más cercano a las coordenadas: con el servidor vacío devuelve nil.

docs.title: Progresión (niveles y habilidades)
docs.text: avalon_combat no tiene un sistema de niveles o habilidades: eso es de tu servidor. El script solo da las herramientas para decidir, para cada jugador o NPC combatiente, qué ataques puede usar y lo fuerte que es. Tu sistema llama a los exports, avalon_combat los aplica.

docs.title: Qué ataques puede usar
docs.text:
• Cada ataque está disponible, salvo que su entrada en el estilo tenga locked = true: entonces empieza bloqueado para todos.
  • SetAttackEnabled(target, estilo, attackId, true | false) desbloquea o bloquea un ataque para ese combatiente y ese estilo. Prevalece sobre el locked del config.
  • attackId es el id del ataque, si no el nombre de su clip. Para un ataque emparejado es su clave en pairs. GetAttacks(estilo) lista todos los ataques de un estilo con id, cadena y locked.
  • Las cadenas del combo (light, heavy, special) y los moves del modo 'keys' son entradas distintas, con id distintos: si tu servidor usa ambos modos, desbloquea ambos.
  • Un ataque bloqueado se salta: en el combo el botón pasa al siguiente disponible de la cadena (ninguno disponible: el botón no hace nada); en el modo 'keys' el movimiento no se elige; R no ejecuta el ataque emparejado. Los NPC solo usan sus ataques disponibles.
  • El servidor descarta los golpes de un ataque bloqueado: un cliente modificado tampoco puede usarlo.

docs.title: Lo fuerte que es
docs.text:
Export Efecto SetAttackMultiplier(target, estilo, attackId, m) Multiplica el daño de un ataque SetOutgoingMultiplier(target, m) Multiplica todo su daño SetDefence(target, { percent, flat }) Defensa propia, sumada a la de la guardia o el escudo SetMaxGuard(target, max) Puntos de guardia máximos (modo 'points') SetInputMode(target, 'combo' \| 'keys') Modo de entrada del combatiente SetStyle(target, estilo, armas) · SetHeld(target, slot, clave) Estilo y armas de jugadores y NPC (por ejemplo desde la clase o el inventario)

Cada Set... tiene su Get... para leer el valor actual.

No se guarda nada

La progresión vive en memoria: cuando el jugador sale (o un NPC se detiene) vuelve a los valores del config. Guardarla es tarea de tu sistema, que la vuelve a enviar en cada entrada, por ejemplo cuando se carga el personaje.

-- server: tu sistema de niveles
local Unlocks = { -- nivel mínimo por ataque, por estilo
    katana = { ['combo@a03@rm'] = 5, ['combo@a04@rm'] = 10, ['combo@d03@rm'] = 15 },
}

local function applyProgress(src, level)
    for style, attacks in pairs(Unlocks) do
        for attackId, minLevel in pairs(attacks) do
            exports.avalon_combat:SetAttackEnabled(src, style, attackId, level >= minLevel)
        end
    end
    exports.avalon_combat:SetOutgoingMultiplier(src, 1.0 + level * 0.02) -- +2% de daño por nivel
end

AddEventHandler('mylevels:loaded', applyProgress)  -- personaje cargado
AddEventHandler('mylevels:levelUp', applyProgress) -- nuevo nivel

docs.title: Exportaciones Disponibles
docs.text: Un target es el ID de servidor de un jugador o { net = netId } para un NPC combatiente.

docs.title: Exports Server-Side
docs.text: Export Descripción SetStyle(target, estilo \| nil, armas) Pone al combatiente en combate con ese estilo. armas: { weapon, offhand, shield }, cada una una clave de la config, false para la mano vacía, ausente para la del estilo. nil saca a un jugador del combate (un NPC se quita con StopFighter) GetStyle(target) Estilo actual del combatiente SetHeld(target, slot, clave \| nil) Arma ('weapon', 'offhand') o escudo ('shield') en la mano, manteniendo el estilo GetHeld(target) { slot = clave } SpawnFighter(estilo, coords, heading, opts) Crea un NPC combatiente, devuelve el net id StopFighter(net) Quita un NPC combatiente AddHitHandler(fn) / RemoveHitHandler(id) Función llamada en cada golpe (ver abajo) GetDamageMode() 'native' o 'external' React(target, qué) Hace ejecutar 'stagger', 'knockdown' o 'death' al objetivo SetAttackEnabled(target, estilo, attackId, on) / IsAttackEnabled(...) Desbloquea o bloquea un ataque para ese combatiente SetAttackMultiplier(target, estilo, attackId, m) / GetAttackMultiplier(...) Multiplicador de un ataque SetOutgoingMultiplier(target, m) / GetOutgoingMultiplier(target) Multiplicador sobre todo su daño SetDefence(target, { percent, flat }) / GetDefence(target) Defensa propia, sumada a la de la guardia GetGuard / SetGuard / GetMaxGuard / SetMaxGuard Puntos de guardia (modo 'points') SetInputMode(target, 'combo' \| 'keys' \| nil) / GetInputMode(target) Modo de input del combatiente GetStyles() Todos los estilos cargados GetAttacks(estilo) { { id, chain, clip, mult, locked, input } } GetWeapon(clave) / GetShield(clave) Entrada del config

docs.title: El golpe (hit)
docs.text:
Los hit handlers y el evento avalon_combat:hit reciben esta tabla:

Campo Descripción mode 'native' o 'external' attacker { kind = 'player' \| 'fighter', src, net, style, team } victim { kind = 'player' \| 'fighter' \| 'ped', src, net, style } attack { id, chain, clip, mult, knockdown, react } (chain: light, heavy, special, moves, pair) weapon { slot, key, data } si ha golpeado una hoja, si no nil base Daño del arma o del estilo attackMult, progressMult, outgoingMult Los tres multiplicadores damage Daño antes de la guardia guard { blocked, parried, broken, percent, flat, cost } final Daño después de la guardia (el aplicado en 'native') direction { x, y } de quien ataca hacia la víctima

Los handlers se ejecutan después del cálculo de la guardia. Un handler devuelve el golpe modificado, nil para dejarlo como está o false para anularlo. Los handlers de un recurso que se detiene se eliminan solos.

-- server: resistencias y niveles
exports.avalon_combat:AddHitHandler(function(hit)
    if hit.victim.kind == 'player' and HasSilverArmor(hit.victim.src) and hit.attacker.style == 'werewolf' then
        hit.final = hit.final * 0.5 -- redondeado por el servidor después de los handlers
        return hit
    end
end)

-- server: DamageMode = 'external', vida gestionada por tu sistema
AddEventHandler('avalon_combat:hit', function(hit)
    if hit.victim.kind ~= 'player' then return end
    local hp = MyHealth.Remove(hit.victim.src, hit.final)
    if hp <= 0 then exports.avalon_combat:React(hit.victim.src, 'death') end
end)

Eventos server (AddEventHandler, reciben el golpe): avalon_combat:hit (modo 'external'), avalon_combat:blocked, avalon_combat:parried, avalon_combat:guardBroken.

docs.title: Exports Client-Side
docs.text:
Export Devuelve GetStyle() Estilo actual o nil IsBlocking() boolean IsAttacking() boolean GetGuard() { v, max } puntos de guardia (modo 'points') GetStamina() Stamina del juego, tal como la lee el modo 'stamina' SetCombatEnabled(on) false deja los controles al juego (menú, cutscene) hasta que vuelve a true GetCastPoint() vector3 desde el que salen las magias del bastón, o nil GetInputMode() 'combo' o 'keys' MakeFighter(ped, estilo, opts) / StopFighter(ped) Convierte un ped en combatiente, o lo detiene

Evento local avalon_combat:onHurt (ped, info, attacker): en cada golpe recibido por un ped gestionado por este cliente, para un HUD.

-- client: barra de vida y números de daño
AddEventHandler('avalon_combat:onHurt', function(ped, info, attacker)
    if ped ~= PlayerPedId() then return end
    if info.parried then
        ShowText('¡PARADA!')
    elseif info.blocked then
        ShowText(('-%d (parado)'):format(info.damage))
    else
        ShowText(('-%d'):format(info.damage))
    end
end)

-- client: nada de combate mientras el menú está abierto
exports.avalon_combat:SetCombatEnabled(false)
